states.effect: Both boxes scratched. The card is the Containment Specialist companion, and the sea search opens door 65 or grants 1 action if 65 is already open.

rules: Black Player card for Antananarivo. Port: the compass has an anchor.
Two scratch boxes, searched independently. State 2 is land only. State 3 is sea only. State 4 is both. Every state side A is the unchanged player-card back.
Land: Companion Containment Specialist. Play this card at any time to remove all Plague cubes from 1 location on the grid.
Sea: the same lost haven as Dar es Salaam. Open door 65 and add it to the board, or gain 1 action if 65 is already open.
notes: Card id 10714. State card ids: state 2 is 10726, state 3 is 10725, state 4 is 10724.
Printed code P7-15b stays on every scratched face.
Playing the card for the Containment Specialist effect uses the card up. The sea result is resolved when that box is scratched, which can be before the card is played.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened. A second, non-search Antananarivo Player card is card 16.
